note: Tool care and smithing variants (catalog Phase 2c, master s2.2, s2.7 items 5-6, s2.9, s4 items 1, 2, 15, 16; read by src/shared/smithing_rules.gd on server and client). Every number here is s5 tuning for playtest. Durability: a tool breaks at its current maximum (the instance's max_d, else items.json durability); a row with no repair is disposable and is gone at zero; a metal tool stays broken in its slot until repaired at its repair_station with its repair materials, which sets its wear to 0 (its maximum is unchanged). Sharpness (rows with edge: true): each use adds its wear to the instance's sharp; it is fully dull at dull_share of the row durability (more for Tempered and craftsmanship: dull_slower); a fully dull tool wears dull_wear_mult times as fast. Sharpening (R on a dull edge tool, then the other dull edge tools one after another) restores sharpness to 100 % and lowers max_d by sharpen_cost of the row durability for a full sharpening, in proportion to what it restored; a whetstone needs a sound whetstone in the pack and water at hand (a filled water container in the pack, or drinkable water within the thirst reach), takes full_s for a fully dull tool (less in proportion), seat_speed times faster sitting on a seat, and stops when the player walks move_m away or the water or whetstone goes; the grindstone (station grindstone) needs no water and is faster. Variants: craftsmanship +1/+2 only at a Master smithy that serves the recipe, Tempered only for steel rows (temper.material, or the ids in temper.include) at a Master smithy that serves the recipe (its quenching trough is built in, master s2.7 item 9); eligible rows are single unstackable items of the eligible kinds (no ammunition, materials or food); max_d is set once at craft: durability x (1 + temper durability + craft level x craft durability), the bonuses add, never multiply.

station_wear.note: GOALS-REPAIR R3/R5 (master s2.2 item 9, s2.7 item 5): every craft finished at a smithy (structures.json anvil) adds per_craft to its use wear; a craft that works a hard_metals ingot or makes a hard_metals product on a bronze anvil adds iron_on_bronze times that. At durability (by the smithy's anvil) the smithy is broken: it stays placed, and crafting, opening its store and taking it down say Needs repair. A hammer on Repair (building_wear.json) mends it: the smithy's blueprint cost less repair_skip, times building_wear repair_share and the share it lost, from the ground, nearby storage and the pack, all or nothing. Read by src/stream/server_smithy.gd. iron_on_bronze PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-17); durability PROVISIONAL (A-25); repair_skip PROVISIONAL (A-26).
station_wear.repair_skip_note: A worn smithy is mended, never rebuilt: its anvil is not paid again (the Advanced smithy's Iron anvil, the Master smithy's Steel anvil).

temper.station_note: GOALS-REPAIR R5 (master s2.7 item 9, s4 item 15): Tempered only at the Master smithy, whose quenching trough is built in; the standalone Quenching trough no longer tempers (master s3.3 legacy rows, CATALOG_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN s1).
temper.include_note: s4 item 15: steel tools by material (above); the steel weapons and armour of s3.6 and s3.7 by id, since their rows carry no material (ammunition stacks and is never eligible; the Steel - Plate barding is s3.10, outside s4 item 15)
